Create ONE standalone icon on a genuinely transparent background, no white card or paper rectangle. Monochrome charcoal black ink only, with restrained grey ink hatching and transparent negative spaces. Polished hand-drawn woodcut/map-engraving quality, not a generic UI symbol, not photorealistic and not a 3D render. No map pin, no enclosing badge or border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no drop shadow, no background scenery. Maintain a consistent compact atlas icon style.
